g.text: Endpoint comparison | separately trained 2-step and 4-step models

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #333333

g.text: 128 training / 159 development Cases | fixed final epoch 50 | connecting lines compare distinct fitted models
Development screening only; Case-to-patient mapping unverified; no clinical validation.
Frozen image features; no augmentation; same 50 epochs and data exposure, different compute costs.
Means of 3 fitted runs, not an ensemble. Bands/error bars: +/- sample SD across seeds, not confidence intervals.
Final epoch 50 fixed; no best-epoch selection. Dice: 224 x 224 letterbox valid pixels.
